name: Raboot
description: Raboot, the Rabbit Pokémon, and the evolved form of Scorbunny. Able to evolve into Cinderace. A Fire type.
pokedex_entries: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
